## Durable Findings

- PostToolUse payload includes `session_id`, `tool_name`, `tool_input.file_path` — confirmed from structural-map-layer research Q2
- `dirty-files.json` exists and is written by `cortex-validator-trigger.sh` (PostToolUse) — tracks files written during execute/repair mode only; not a general edit ledger
- Stop hook (`cortex-session-end.sh`) fires after EVERY agent response turn, not at session termination — payload confirmed from hook source
- TaskCompleted hook (`cortex-task-completed.sh`) enforces validators — payload schema to be confirmed in research
